hotel.name: The Ritz Carlton Al Wadi Desert

verified_facts.text: The resort sits within a gated private nature reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in a 1,235-acre gated private Nature Reserve

verified_facts.text: The resort opened as a Banyan Tree resort in 2010 and became a Ritz-Carlton property in 2017.
verified_facts.excerpt: Originally opened as a Banyan Tree resort back in 2010, the resort became a Ritz-Carlton property in 2017.

verified_facts.text: The resort is in the Al Wadi Nature Reserve, which is home to gazelles and Arabian oryx.
verified_facts.excerpt: It sits in the Al Wadi Nature Reserve, established in 2010 and today home to gazelles and Arabian Oryxes

verified_facts.text: Each villa features a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each features a private pool, expansive living space, refined interiors and uninterrupted views

verified_facts.text: Signature villas with private mini-gyms and an infinity-edge pool opened in 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the opening of eight new two-bedroom signature villas in 2024, each spanning 900 square metres of indoor and outdoor space with sunbeds, sofas, living and dining areas, private mini-gyms, and an infinity-edge pool

verified_facts.text: Signature villa guests are welcomed by a private butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: A private Butler, welcomes you with a complimentary bottle of Champagne

verified_facts.text: The tented villas have canopied ceilings and brass lanterns.
verified_facts.excerpt: dark wood detailing, canopied ceilings, brass lanterns, and huge bathrooms

verified_facts.text: The spa's Rainforest combines European hydrothermal culture with Middle Eastern bathing rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Rainforest combines European hydrothermal culture with Middle Eastern bathing rituals, creating a rejuvenating sanctuary in the Arabian desert.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers the Arabian Sand Tide Journey, performed on a treatment table topped with quartz sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: try the Arabian Sand Tide Journey, performed on a treatment table topped by a layer of quartz sand

verified_facts.text: A Falcon and Owl show takes place daily one hour before sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Witness the majestic beauty of the falcon in an interactive Falcon and Owl show daily, one hour before sunset.

verified_facts.text: The Experience Concierge introduces guests to falconry, archery, fishing, desert biking, horseback riding and stargazing.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests are introduced to falconry, archery, fishing, desert biking, horseback riding, stargazing and other activities

verified_facts.text: An early morning experience lets guests feed the resident oryx and gazelles in the nature reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: This early morning experience invites guests to feed the resident Oryx and gazelles in the Al Wadi Desert Nature Reserve.

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids offers children educational activities about the desert.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids invites young explorers to discover the wonders of the desert through engaging, educational activities.

verified_facts.text: Zuma at the resort serves Japanese izakaya-style dining, with a menu from sushi to robata grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu showcases a variety of dishes from sushi to robata grill.

verified_facts.text: The coast is a twenty-minute drive from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: You could drive twenty minutes to Ras Al Khaimah’s coast, but there’s really no need.

verified_facts.text: Guests receive complimentary access to a sister resort's beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary guest access to its sister resort’s beach

verified_facts.text: The Al Wadi Equestrian Centre is run by a third-party operator independently from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Al Wadi Equestrian Centre is a third-party operator who manages the Equestrian Centre and Equestrian Activities independently from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary Vitality Pool access is subject to availability and is for guests aged 16 and above.
verified_facts.excerpt: access is subject to availability and is available to guests aged 16 and above

verified_facts.text: Kan Zaman is a seasonal restaurant serving Arabic cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kan Zaman - Seasonal

verified_facts.text: Desert temperatures can drop sharply at night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come nighttime, the desert temperatures can drop precipitously and it is wise to have a jacket on hand.
